catalysts.headline: Trump-Xi summit in Washington Thursday 09-24 (Xi's first US visit since 2015): agenda is tariff-truce extension (truce runs to 11-10), critical minerals/rare earths, chips export controls, and a proposed US-China AI dialogue; Nvidia's Huang, OpenAI's Altman, Qualcomm's Amon, Microsoft's Nadella and Tim Cook attend the White House dinner
catalysts.magnitude: SME-control direction: no public sign of easing (Aju Press 09-18); US pushing for more restrictions (WEF); the only easing on record is H200 case-by-case licensing in January, which is AI accelerators, not equipment. Skew for AMAT/KLAC/LRCX/ASML is no-change to tighter, so the summit is NOT established as positive convexity for equipment names. Upside case is limited to a tariff-truce extension (truce ends 11-10). Congressional MATCH Act (servicing ban on CXMT/YMTC/Hua Hong tools) is the tightening tail; not moved this window. No control change is quantified in any source; TER withdrawn from affects (no China-SME mechanism established).
catalysts.revision_note: TER withdrawn from affects; exposure restated to 37.0% eq / 29.7% book

catalysts.headline: Nvidia-OpenAI vendor financing stays the standing financing-structure overhang: Nvidia backing up to $105bn for OpenAI's Ohio datacentre (4.25GW initial, +3.75GW option, SB Energy builds, 20-yr lease), plus talks on financing up to ~$350bn of OpenAI chip purchases on top of $30bn already invested
catalysts.magnitude: Restated as a lasting fact, not new this window (CNBC 08-17; the 07-27 $250bn backstop talks preceded it). Supports demand for chips and memory (tailwind) while concentrating counterparty risk in one customer (threat); the $350bn figure comes from a search-summary paraphrase and is unverified. No new financing headline found today.

catalysts.headline: Semis rally 09-21: SOX up >2% to its highest since 09-09 on oil falling below $100 and the 10y easing to just under 5%, into the Trump-Xi summit; no company-specific catalyst named

Oil 'below $100' is a news paraphrase with no two-print check, so it is NOT used as a classified mechanism. Rebound partly reverses the 09-14 -4.75% SMH day; no fundamental change.

catalysts.headline: Oracle-leased Project Jupiter (New Mexico) datacentre loans of ~$18bn quoted at 89-91c by syndicate banks; sale to wider investors stalled on Oracle's rising borrowing and weakening credit (FT via Reuters)
catalysts.magnitude: One project, one lessee: a 9-11 point discount on ~$18bn (roughly $1.6-2.0bn of mark-to-market), no default and no capex cut reported. Financing-structure signal for OpenAI-linked capacity via Oracle; ORCL is exited so held exposure is nil. NBIS (3.9% eq / 3.1% book) read-through is UNPROVEN: Vineland is a separate project and no NBIS debt discount is sourced.
